footer.about: Mondapac is a Brisbane marketplace for local food sellers: halal butchers, bakers, pantry makers and more. Every product shows where it comes from, and certificates such as halal are checked by our team before a label appears. Prices include GST, and each seller shows its own delivery window and minimum order.

faq.start-q: What do I need to start?
faq.start-a: An email address to create the account. Later you will need your {identifier}, business name and address, and a halal certificate if you want the halal badge on your products.
faq.account-q: Can I use my shopping account?
faq.account-a: No. Seller accounts are separate from shopping accounts and have their own email and password.
faq.review-q: How long does the review take?
faq.review-a: We review each seller by hand. We email you as soon as there is a result, and you can see the status when you sign in.
faq.certificate-q: Do I need a halal certificate to sell?
faq.certificate-a: No. You can sell without one. The verified halal badge is shown only when we have checked a valid certificate.
